source_scope: KAIMAN/KERAKAM WT1.2 sheets 22-39, physical PDF pages 62-79
key_findings: WT1.2 standard plastered wall stack is 20 + 380 + 15 = 415 mm on the repeated standard sheets.
Window sections 24 and 36 print storey 3000 mm, sill 920 mm and clear opening 1680 mm.
Sheet 27 prints external wall 415 mm and internal KERAKAM 25XL wall 15 + 250 + 15 = 280 mm.
Sheet 28 prints 250-260 mm normal block course lengths and 129 mm KERAKAM 38+ closure units at the opening.
Mansard/cold-attic sheets preserve source anchor M12, L=225 mm and recommended 80 mm embedment as source technical guidance only.
Monolithic slab-edge sheets print 160 mm main slab + 60 mm downstand and 120 + 100 + 160 mm horizontal edge segmentation.
Plinth sheet 33 is a local exception: the upper wall is printed 15 + 380 + 15 = 410 mm; this does not overwrite the 415 mm WT1.2 standard stack.
Wood-beam sheet 38 prints 200 mm beam depth, 250 mm bearing, 20 mm top/bottom clearance, and 120 + 10 + 250 = 380 mm wall-pocket segmentation.
